# smart-immunizations-annexes

The web annexes this IG's pages load on demand. `annexes.json` (`ig-annexes/v1`) places each on its page: `../web-annexes/dak-data-dictionary.json` on `dictionary.md` (six columns shown, the rest opened per row), `personas-swimlanes.md` on `personas.md` and `processes-swimlanes.md` on `business-processes.md`. The two swimlane annexes are appended to their pages as written: each persona with the processes whose swimlanes name it, and each process figure's lanes with the persona each is or why it is not one. smart-base's `dak-swimlanes.ts` writes them from `input/pagecontent/personas.md`, the business-process figures and `input/business-processes/swimlanes.json`: regenerate them, never edit them; its QA record goes to `test/results/` on the qa branch. fhir-harness's IG site build (`stage-ig-sites` for an index, `ig-repo-site.ts compose` for this repository's own site) finds the directory through this `ig-annex` declaration. An IG repository commits no artefact index, so this is a directory of its own, not `fhir-artifact-index/`.

Part of [WHO SMART Guidelines — Immunizations](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-immunizations-annexes`, holding `ig-annex`.

| file | what it is | used by |

| [`personas-swimlanes.md`](personas-swimlanes.md) | text |  |
